text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While tidying up in the trainer's office,
Fuji Kiseki came in.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Trainer-san...
Do you happen to have any spare tissues?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I completely forgot to order the dorm supplies.
And I really don't feel like going out shopping, either...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll return it once the supplies arrive.
Sorry about that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, Fuji Kiseki left the Trainer's office
empty-handed...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoops! I forgot
to grab some tissues!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haa... What on earth am I doing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fatigue must have built up from running so many races lately...
I should probably adjust her schedule.
